text:
Marissa Cole: syncing on Console beta scope for Shadow Experiments. want to lock “must-have UX” so eng/design can stop churn. for beta (Dedicated first) what *has* to be in creation + results? drop thoughts here.

Kenji Nakamura: from design side: need a clean creation flow w/ guardrails. if we ship a screen that looks half-baked, customers will assume we can’t trust results.

Dylan Brooks: +1. also we need to be careful what we promise. scoring lag + missing data are going to happen in beta.

Paula Mendes: minimum to call it usable:
1) create shadow experiment attached to an existing Route or Rollout
2) see quality delta over time with confidence interval (or at least “not enough samples” state)
3) drill into examples to debug *why* a metric moved
4) export so teams can share internally

Marissa Cole: yup, those are the four bullets. can we define exactly what “create” and “results” include?

Chloe Martin: creation flow: can we constrain to “from a route” (route picker) + “shadow target(s)” and a sampling %. everything else advanced accordion.

Kenji Nakamura: proposal for beta create flow sections:
- Context: Route (required), optionally link to an active Rollout/Canary (if launched from Rollouts page)
- Variants: Control = current route target, Shadow = one or more candidate targets
- Sampling: % traffic mirrored (default 1%?) + note about cost
- Data handling: show retention + redaction defaults (read-only for Hosted, configurable for Dedicated?)
- Metrics: choose metric bundle (Default v1 only in beta)
- Review: summary + “start experiment”

Dylan Brooks: i’d like “start” to be very explicit that user responses are unchanged. we should literally show a callout: “Shadow responses are NOT served to end users.”

Marissa Cole: yes. copy needs to be idiot-proof.

Elliot Price: for copy/tooltips, can add:
- “Shadowing is best-effort and fail-open; if the shadow path fails, production is unaffected.”
- “Metrics may be delayed while scoring catches up.”
- “Some examples may be redacted/truncated.”

Paula Mendes: RBAC must-have: only users w/ Rollouts Admin or Route Admin can create/edit. viewers can view results. we need this in beta otherwise enterprise security review blocks.

Chloe Martin: RBAC is already in the experiments service but we need UI states: disabled create button + permission error page + audit log link.

Dylan Brooks: results page must-haves (beta):
- Header: Experiment status (Running / Paused / Stopped), started at, route, control/shadow IDs, sampling %
- “Data freshness” indicator (scoring lag) + last processed timestamp
- A delta chart for each default metric (control vs shadow) + absolute + relative diff
- Confidence band / error bars OR at minimum show sample count + “insufficient data” gating

Kenji Nakamura: charting: for beta, can we do a single “Quality deltas” section with top 3 metrics, then expandable list for the rest? don’t want a 20-chart scroll.

Marissa Cole: agree. we should optimize for “is it worse?” decisioning.

Paula Mendes: also need segmentation filters. customers will ask “is regression only in German?” “only on tool-calling?” etc.

Dylan Brooks: segmentation scares me re: cardinality + UX scope.

Chloe Martin: what if beta only supports 2-3 safe filters (predefined):
- request type (chat vs completions)
- region (if present)
- model family (control/shadow are known)
No free-form tags.

Paula Mendes: ok for beta. but we should at least allow “time window” (last 1h/24h/7d).

Kenji Nakamura: + pin the default view to last 24h with a “not enough samples” message and recommended sampling if needed.

Marissa Cole: example drilldown must-have details:
- show control output + shadow output side-by-side
- show per-example scores for the default metrics
- show redaction state (e.g., “[redacted: email]”)
- allow “copy JSON” of the example payload for debugging

Dylan Brooks: careful on “payload” — in Dedicated beta we can show hashed IDs + truncated prompt. for Hosted we probably can’t show raw prompts by default.

Chloe Martin: we can implement an Example viewer with three tabs:
1) Summary (scores + outcome)
2) Outputs (control/shadow text)
3) Metadata (request fingerprint, model IDs, rubric version, timestamps)
Prompt content behind a “may be redacted” placeholder if redaction applied.

Paula Mendes: do we need “mark as interesting” / “add note” for examples? probably not beta.

Marissa Cole: not beta.

Elliot Price: export must-have: CSV for metric aggregates + JSONL for sampled examples? Or just one?

Dylan Brooks: i think we need:
- Export aggregates CSV (time series optional; at least current window summary)
- Export examples JSONL (limited to N, respect redaction)
Also “copy link” deep links that preserve filters.

Kenji Nakamura: UX detail: export as dropdown: “Summary CSV” + “Sampled examples (JSONL)”. show note: “Exports include redactions and may omit prompt fields depending on policy.”

Marissa Cole: what about attaching to rollouts? must-have is just a link, not full automation.

Paula Mendes: yep. for beta: in Rollout detail page, show “Shadow experiment: Running” with a link. no auto rollback in beta.

Dylan Brooks: + if there’s a regression, we can show a warning banner but not block rollout actions.

Chloe Martin: states we must handle in results UI:
- scoring pipeline down (show banner + last known)
- zero samples collected (misconfig or too low traffic)
- shadow target errors (elevated error rate) but remind that prod isn’t impacted
- experiment stopped (freeze view; allow changing time window)

Kenji Nakamura: can design explicit empty/error states. if we don’t, the page looks broken.

Talia Benson: capturing as beta UX must-haves checklist:
- Create flow: Route picker, shadow target(s), sampling %, retention/redaction callout, default metric bundle selection, explicit “no user impact” warning, RBAC-gated
- Results: status + freshness, top metrics delta view w/ sample size + confidence/insufficient-data gating, limited safe filters + time window
- Example drilldown: side-by-side outputs, per-example scores, metadata, copy JSON
- Export: summary CSV + examples JSONL (redaction-safe)
- Rollouts integration: link from rollout to experiment + status badge
I’ll paste into Linear + notify DES-611/DES-612/ENG-5408.

Marissa Cole: perfect. also add “pricing/cost warning” in create flow: rough estimate based on sampling.

Dylan Brooks: we can show a simple estimate: “shadow requests ~ X/min” and “scoring may add compute cost” without $ amount.

Paula Mendes: ok but keep it non-committal. :grimacing:

Kenji Nakamura: i’ll add a cost tooltip and a “start with 0.5–1%” recommendation.

Marissa Cole: locked. anything explicitly OUT of scope for beta so we can push back?

Chloe Martin: out of scope (beta):
- custom user-defined metrics/rubrics
- arbitrary segmentation by custom tags
- inline editing of redaction rules
- automated rollout gating/auto-rollback

Dylan Brooks: + no “replay historical traffic” UI.

Marissa Cole: great. thanks all. :thumbsup: (will send summary to Priya + stakeholders)
